description: This Java class 'DeviceCredentialsDataValidator' extends 'DataValidator' to perform validation logic for 'DeviceCredentials' objects, including checks during creation and update, and ensuring data consistency and existence of related device.

classes.name: DeviceCredentialsDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for DeviceCredentials objects, ensuring data integrity and consistency during create and update operations.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates creation of DeviceCredentials, checking for existing credentials for the device and credentials ID conflicts.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates update of DeviceCredentials, ensuring the credentials exist and are not assigned to another device.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of DeviceCredentials data, including device existence and required fields.
